coverage: 1949 nominal administrative snapshot: 35 provinces, Tibet Area, Outer Mongolia (earlier reference extent), Hainan Special Administrative Region (from April 1949), and 12 special-municipality location points. Province cartography is the CC0 1947–1949 reconstruction by Christian Henriot / ENP-China. This is not a military-control map. Municipal territories remain unresolved within the province polygons. Outer Mongolia is a former-claim reference extent from the 1912–1921 configuration, including Tuva; it was not controlled by the ROC in 1949. The ROC recognized Mongolian independence in January 1946; Tuva was incorporated into the USSR in 1944. Coasts, lake treatment and offshore claims are approximate at the source scale.
processing: Historical source polygons projected to WGS84, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places; shared edges stored once. Hainan island components separated for its 1949 administrative status. Outer Mongolia added from the earlier 1912–1921 reference extent, including Tuva, with non-control and recognition dates disclosed. Source-scale coast and lake treatment retained without applying modern land/water masks. Municipality points provide locations only; province geometry contains unresolved municipal cutouts. Modern map data is never rewritten.
